title: Quality-vs-semantic split: does quality transfer and semantic not?
why: Fuse/route the available scorers; decide where deterministic physics rules are valid
hypothesis: Quality sub-problems (dark/blur/overexposed/frozen/duplicate) transfer out-of-domain; semantic sub-problems (no-active-work/hands-not-visible) do not
method: AUROC of {good} vs {bad windows with reason in category} for rules (total/quality-only/semantic-only), frozen ensemble_v1, adapted Z3 model

title: Deterministic regime router: routed system vs single scorers
why: Choose the scorer per regime; report review/error
hypothesis: A descriptor router (resolution/fps/regime) recovers the best scorer per regime and beats every single scorer on mean-domain AUROC
data: IndEgo gold 150 + OOD-160 with E4 regime descriptors
method: Deterministic routers (fps, E4 profile, aspect ratio, quality-gate, rules-review) evaluated by AUROC + calibrated-band review/error

title: Rank-average fusion: adapted x frozen (x rules)
why: Does fusion reduce the ambiguous fraction at equal/better error?
hypothesis: Rank-averaging the adapted score with the frozen ensemble improves grouped AUROC and cuts the review band
method: Rank-average of per-domain rank01 good-scores; AUROC grouped bootstrap; calibrated [0.4,0.6] review proxy
